$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-drawer) and how to read it. skip: spec keys not compared for this layer. header is the header slot, header#1 the title-and-description frame inside it; Swipe handle is the 12 px strip and Bar its pill.

root.$why: The border is outside the box in Figma, drawn as an outer 1 px shadow before the Surface/Dialog shadow. Figma's root is a vertical (side: horizontal, with a Content frame) auto-layout with no padding or gap; code stacks the parts in a flex column.

Swipe handle.$why: Figma's handle is a horizontal auto-layout holding the bar; code centres a ::before pill in a flex strip.
